title: Current tissue list for global enrichment data
bodyHtml:
This page lists the tissues for which global enrichment of GWAS signals in epigenomic annotations is currently calculated in the Knowledge Portals, using stratified LD score regression. These tissues represent broad categories that encompass more detailed "biosamples" (tissue and cell types). Global enrichment is calculated for each of these tissues in a trans-ancestry analysis and for each of the following single ancestries:

  • African American or Afro-Caribbean
  • African unspecified
  • East Asian
  • European
  • Greater Middle Eastern (Middle Eastern, North African, or Persian)
  • Hispanic or Latin American
  • South Asian
  • Sub-Saharan African
